class.name: PS3Module
class.brief_description: PS3 module entry point for SDK metadata.
class.description: Provides PlayStation 3 SDK and firmware information when [code]ps3_module[/code] is enabled in PS3 template builds.

method.name: get_boot_phase
method.description: Returns the last PS3 boot milestone (e.g. [code]early_init[/code], [code]main_entry[/code], [code]modules_loaded[/code]).

method.name: get_memory_available_mb
method.description: Returns approximate user memory budget in megabytes.

method.name: get_firmware_version
method.description: Returns the host/emulator firmware version string when available.
